spanish: Y el pueblo que traiga su cuello en el yugo del rey de Babilonia y le sirva, lo dejaré sobre su tierra, dice el SEÑOR, y le servirá y vivirá en ella.

findings.issue: first עבדו serves the king (ms); second עבדה serves the land (fs); Spanish collapses pronouns and referents
findings.spanishSpan: y le sirva ... y le servirá

findings.issue: ישב is dwell/sit; Spanish renders as vivirá and attaches to wrong pronoun
Hiphil imperfect rendered as subjunctive traiga instead of future indicative
